boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-listed places for quiet study, collaborative work, virtual meetings, or computer-based coursework.

cards.entity_name: Lorette Wilmot Library Main Level and Mezzanine Window Carrels
cards.title: Window Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — main level and mezzanine
cards.notes: Set up at an individual carrel near the windows when you need an alone-and-quiet workspace for reading or drafting.
cards.short_summary: Individual window-side carrels for focused solo work.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists individual study carrels near the windows on the library’s main level and mezzanine for students who prefer to study alone or in silence.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: Library access is associated with a NazCard for students; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Information Desk Tables and Carrels
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — main level
cards.notes: Choose a carrel for personal space or spread materials across a large table near the Information Desk; borrow whiteboard supplies there.
cards.short_summary: Main-level carrels and large tables beside library help.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies study carrels and large tables near the Library Information Desk as study spaces; whiteboard supplies are checked out there.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: Ask at the Information Desk for whiteboard supplies; confirm library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Reading Room Tables
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — main level
cards.notes: Bring a group assignment or a broad reading spread to the large tables beneath the St. Jerome window in the Reading Room.
cards.short_summary: Large-table seating below the St. Jerome window.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists large tables in the Reading Room, below the St. Jerome window, for students who prefer to share tables with others.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: Located on the library main level; confirm library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Rare Book Room Tables
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — main level
cards.notes: Use the room’s tables for a quieter individual or shared session, and check the library’s posted access conditions before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A main-level room with tables for individual or shared study.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies the Rare Book Room as a library study option with tables and states that its study rooms are first come, first served.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: Listed on the main-level library map; library study rooms are first come, first served.

cards.title: Merton Room Tables
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — main level
cards.notes: Use a table in the Merton Room for reading or a small work session, then leave it ready for the next first-come user.
cards.short_summary: Table workspace in the library’s Merton Room.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies the Merton Room as a study option with tables and states that library study rooms are first come, first served.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: Listed on the main-level library map; library study rooms are first come, first served.

cards.title: Lower-Level Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — rooms 101, 102, 103, 106, 120, 121, 123, and 130
cards.notes: Bring collaborators to a lower-level room, use its whiteboard, and arrive ready to claim an available room without a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Whiteboard-equipped group rooms on the library lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists eight lower-level group study rooms and says group study rooms are first come, first served and equipped with whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; whiteboard supplies can be checked out from the Library Information Desk.

cards.title: Group Study Room 239
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — main level
cards.notes: Use Room 239 for a small collaborative session and bring a plan for the whiteboard; it operates on a first-come basis.
cards.short_summary: A main-level, whiteboard-equipped group study room.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Room 239 as the library’s main-level group study room and says group study rooms are first come, first served and equipped with whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; whiteboard supplies are available through the Library Information Desk.

cards.title: Mezzanine Group Study Room 301
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library — mezzanine
cards.notes: Head to the mezzanine for Room 301 when your group needs a dedicated whiteboard room away from the main-level tables.
cards.short_summary: A whiteboard-equipped group room on the library mezzanine.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Room 301 as the mezzanine group study room and says group study rooms are first come, first served and equipped with whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; whiteboard supplies are available through the Library Information Desk.

cards.title: Millie’s Library Atrium
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library
cards.notes: Use the renovated café area for discussion-heavy group work or social studying, and keep the space usable for others around you.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour student social-work space in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth states that the new Millie’s area is suitable for socializing and boisterous group work and is a 24-hour space for students.
cards.source_title: Lorette Wilmot Library — Services and Policies
cards.access_notes: Nazareth identifies this as a 24-hour space for students; food or drinks may require purchase.

cards.title: Smyth 142 Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Smyth Hall — Room 142
cards.notes: Use the lounge’s computers for coursework when other labs are closed, and bring your NazCard to access campus technology spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies Smyth 142 as a 24-hour study lounge with computers available for use.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours with computers for use, per Nazareth ITS; student ID cards are required for computer-lab access.
